roomDay:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production panoramic environment texture for a three-dimensional game artist portfolio, not a website mockup. Generate exactly one seamless 360-degree equirectangular panorama, 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 4096x2048 or highest supported resolution. Full sphere projection, level horizon exactly at the vertical middle, horizontally seamless left/right edges; no frames, panels, typography, people, characters, watermark or portfolio room in this image.
Scene: a refined near-future creative technology campus surrounding an open central courtyard. The foreground 3D room will be rendered separately. Distant grounded architecture ONLY in a low belt around the horizon: navy blue and brushed silver curved architecture, believable connected bridges with supports, layered ribbed facades and glass, a few warm amber accent bands, landscaped edges and mature trees at building bases. Premium hard-surface game environment, physically plausible sunlit architecture, intricate material workmanship rather than noisy greebles. Buildings are 80–250 metres from the observer, never close poles or columns, no object looming in front of the camera. Clear blue sky with broken soft white cloud masses, strong natural late-morning daylight, warm sun from upper-left relative to central view, gentle atmospheric distance and subtle reflections. Avoid spaceship interiors, outer space, floating unsupported towers, dense cyberpunk neon and huge foreground machinery.
Composition: upper half mainly rich sky and clouds with subtle gradients; horizon contains varied but restrained low architectural silhouettes and greenery, lower hemisphere is continuous quiet dark slate courtyard paving grading outward to the campus. Central frontal sector must have depth, sky and architectural layers without a dominant tall object. No huge empty flat white field. Keep a coherent blue-gray / silver / warm amber palette suitable behind a dark navy, metallic, orange-accented miniature room. Image should work as a distant spherical backdrop while orbiting and zooming; do not paint a foreground room, desk, platform or exhibition stand.
galleryDay:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production panoramic environment texture for the glass works-gallery scene of a game art portfolio, not a website layout. Generate exactly one seamless 360-degree equirectangular panorama, 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 4096x2048 or highest supported resolution. Level horizon exactly at vertical middle, full sphere projection, matching left/right seam. No text, borders, captions, people, room diorama, exhibition objects or foreground gallery in the image.
Scene: a sophisticated sunlit coastal cultural campus, seen from an open quiet limestone terrace. In the distant horizon belt, elegant ivory stone and slender brushed-metal museum pavilions with expansive glass, naturally grounded lower terraces, horizontal connecting promenades, Mediterranean greenery with a few architectural trees. Across part of the panorama is an open pale turquoise bay and distant blue mountain shoreline; another sector has layered white modern architecture. This is the setting surrounding a separately rendered silver curved glass display corridor, so never paint the actual glass corridor or exhibits. Clean editorial architectural visualization with highly believable material, indirect sunlight and aerial perspective; futuristic but warm and human-scaled. Distant geometry 100+ metres away, no close vertical pillars, no masts, no giant futuristic skyscrapers, no floating assets, no visual clutter.
Lighting: luminous natural afternoon daylight, champagne warm sun glancing across limestone, clear softly clouded blue sky, subtle silver and warm bronze accents, reflective glass, restrained pale olive greenery. Sky takes upper half, a detailed low skyline at horizon, lower hemisphere is continuous muted warm limestone terrace/ground receding toward landscape with subtle natural joints and soft light. Keep foreground quiet to support the real 3D scene. Avoid empty gray backdrops, stark black space, excessive bloom or science-fiction neon. A polished, expansive but composed architectural environment, with a clearly distinct lighter palette from a dark blue high-tech studio.
